nom: Kate Somerville EradiKate 3% Sulfur Daily Foaming Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who call it very oily, say the wash reduces excess oil, minimizes pores, and clears blackheads, though a few note it leaves oily skin feeling noticeably tighter or drier than usual after use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several caution it can be too drying for dry or sensitive skin and recommend limiting it to a mask once or twice a week, while others with dry or dry/combination skin say it left them feeling moisturized rather than dry and tight.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say the wash suits both the oilier and drier areas of their face without leaving it feeling stripped.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including some with rosacea or acne-prone sensitive skin, report the wash doesn't irritate them despite the active sulfur, though those who are also dry are advised to use it only as an occasional mask rather than daily.
segments.mature: One older reviewer who avoids Botox reports using the wash as a T-zone mask cleared persistent light pimples and also soothed irritated, reddened skin near her eyebrows that a zinc soap had not helped.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers are divided on dryness: many, including some with dry or combination skin, say the wash doesn't leave their face feeling dry, tight, or stripped even with daily use; a substantial number of others, however, report it dries out their skin, in one case peeling like a sunburn, and recommend limiting use to once a day, using it only as an occasional mask, or following up with a rich moisturizer or serum.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers with rosacea, perioral dermatitis, or generally inflamed, red skin report a significant reduction in redness and swelling, in several cases resolving symptoms that other products and even prescriptions hadn't fixed; none in this set report the wash itself causing new redness.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers specifically describe the wash as gentle on the skin barrier even while it treats their acne, cleansing thoroughly without stripping everything away.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a fading of acne scars and marks from healed breakouts with continued use, though one still has some visible scarring even as her overall skin brightens.
concerns.blemishes: The great majority of reviewers, including many with hormonal, cystic, or teenage acne, report significantly clearer skin, faster-healing blemishes, and fewer blackheads and whiteheads, though many describe an initial purging period of extra breakouts before things improve; a smaller number say it didn't help their acne, that they still get occasional breakouts, or that the formula's coconut-derived ingredients triggered their worst breakout.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report a visible reduction in oil production and shine with continued use, in one case describing skin that no longer feels oily at all.

aspects.libelle: Expensive, but reviewers say worth it
A little goes a long way
Doubles well as a leave-on mask

extraits.texte: When you have moderate to severe adult cystic acne, its hard to tell what products are helping or hurting the condition, but Im on my 3rd tube of this face wash and I have the following opinions. Its expensive but it does feel luxury and my face always feels clean after using it. When I first used it, I loved how different it was. It has a clay mask texture and sulfur. However, after continued use, I dont think its helping my acne but I dont think its whats causing my continued breakouts either. I still have blackheads, small and medium size white heads and cystic breakouts every now and then. I would expext it to at least help the small pimples. I think its too drying to use morning and night and Id rather spend on pricier items like serums or other acne medication.

I've been using this cleanser for a few months. I was hoping it would be more effective at diminishing sebaceous filaments, as it was recommended by a dermatologist, however, so far I gave not seen much improvement. No noticeable reduction in pore size. If you have acne, it may be more helpful for you.

I'm not one who usually leaves reviews, HOWEVER, after battling acne prone skin for years this cleanser has got to be the best one I have come across. It literally rids my face of whiteheads and blackheads after one use. I have super oily skin and this works perfect. However, I will say, to get the best use of it you need to massage into skin atleast for a minute for it to work, any less and it doesn't work nearly as well.
My skin has never felt so good and soft before. It really deep cleanser my pores. I have dry skin and this product doesn't male my skin more dry and tight. Love it!

Hopping on her becasue I see this hasn't been reveiwed by anyone yet, which shocks me. This is a thick and foamy facewash that actually feels like it absorbs into your skin and treats it. After rinsing it off, my skin is super soft and supple feeling and I notice my redness is noticiably reduced after my face calms down from the wash. I used this to get my face ready for my wedding, followed by Kate Sommerville's ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer and it seemed to be the dynamic duo that I was looking for. I have red, acne prone / roscea skin and this seriously helped keep everytnig calm. Side note: my bridesmaid borrowed this and the ExfoliKate Moisturizer for 2 nights, and she doesn't have acne prone or red skin, but she also LOVED how it felt.

This is by far the best cleanser I've ever used. I'm 20 years old with sensitive combination skin (mostly dry especially in the colder seasons but sometimes oily on my forehead). I don't have bad acne, just a few pimples that appear sometimes (usually hormonal). I work at Ulta, so I've tried MANY different types of cleansers. This is the only cleanser that gets rid of my pimples within 2 washes. I'm truly obsessed and have been using for about 3-4 months now. This can also be used as a mask. It doesn't leave my skin feeling irritated, tight, dry, or stripped, like I've had issues with in the past with other cleansers. If you have stubborn pimples and are looking for something new I would definitely give this a try! I've recommended this to so many people who have also ended up loving it. It's 100% worth the price in my opinion. Make sure you're applying on wet skin! It definitely makes a difference. You only need a very small amount, this will last you months. I would give it about a week or two of consistent use to see results. The only thing I don't like is the smell, but I can get past that with how amazing my skin looks and feels. I live by this stuff!!

I am older. I use "frownies" rather than Botox, and find that my forehead is aggravated with light pimples. Ugh! So I bought this and wear as a mask on my t-zone in the morning (wash off in my shower). Magic. No pimples. Also, I have red, irritated skin around my eyebrows (dandruff according to my dermatologist). The zinc soap they told me to use did nothing. But this amazing Kate product completely soothed the area which is now v happy. Totally unexpected but great additional benefit. If I had found this when my daughter was in middle and high school we would have been spared tears. GREAT product.
